user.title: Add a MojiPic display
user.description:
Leave 'Scan for a MojiPic' on and Home Assistant will look for one, or type the address yourself (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

If nothing is found: {help_not_found}

reconfigure.title: Upload an image
reconfigure.description: Choose a PNG or JPEG. It is cropped to fit the 32x32 panel, saved, and shown on the display straight away. Stored images can be re-selected at any time from the MojiPic image selector.

data_description.file: Pick a file already in your Home Assistant config directory, or upload a new one.

error.scan_failed: The Bluetooth scan could not complete. This usually means Home Assistant has no usable Bluetooth adapter. Check Settings, System, Hardware, or that an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is set up and powered. The full error is in the Home Assistant log.
error.no_bluetooth: Home Assistant cannot see a Bluetooth adapter. {no_bluetooth_help}
error.invalid_address: That does not look like a Bluetooth address. Use the format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.not_readable: That file could not be found. Try again, or copy the image into your Home Assistant config directory first.
error.bad_image: That file could not be read as an image. Please choose a PNG or JPEG.
error.unknown: Something went wrong uploading that image. Check the log for details.

abort.reload_required: The display is not loaded right now. Reload the integration and try again.

upload_image.name: Upload image
upload_image.description: Store an image for display on the MojiPic. PNG and JPEG are supported. Note that photographs at 32x32 are inherently rough; icons and emoji look much better.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path to an image inside the Home Assistant config directory.

image_id.name: Image id
image_id.description: Optional id to store at. Defaults to the next free slot.

image_id.name: Image id
image_id.description: The id of the image to delete.

display_stored.name: Display stored image
display_stored.description: Display an image previously uploaded with 'Upload image'.

image_id.name: Image id
image_id.description: The id of the image to display.

display_image.name: Display image file
display_image.description: Display an image directly from a file, without storing it first.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path to an image inside the Home Assistant config directory.

rescan.name: Rescan for display
rescan.description: Look for the display again and update the remembered address.
